### Borea v0.6.6

A patch release that makes updates of Borea more reliable and completes the Simplified Chinese translation again. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### What's new

- An update of Borea no longer stops when GitHub fails to serve one of its files.
- Borea then fetches that file through the GitHub API and checks it the same way as before.

#### Simplified Chinese

- Simplified Chinese now covers every text in Borea again, including the "What's new" texts and the Statistics texts that v0.6.5 added. Thanks to @kuxiaowo.

#### Good to know

- If the update to v0.6.5 stopped with "SHA256SUMS.txt could not be downloaded", this version fixes it.
- Borea offers v0.6.6 directly, so you do not need to install v0.6.5 first.

Full changelog: [v0.6.5...v0.6.6](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.5...v0.6.6)
